localizedNames.es: Prueba en el punto de atención sanitaria

localizedDescriptions.de: Dies gibt an, ob der Test direkt am Point-of-Care (POCT) durchgeführt wurde, im Gegensatz zu einem formalen Ergebnis eines Labors oder einer anderen Dienstleistungsorganisation.
localizedDescriptions.fi: *This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Indikerar om analysen utfördes som en patientnära analys (PNA), det vill säga på vårdenhet, istället för en mer formell laboratorietjänst.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: *This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.en: This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.it: Questo elemento indica se il test è stato eseguito direttamente presso il punto di assistenza (Point-of-Care, POCT), rispetto a un risultato formale di un laboratorio o di un'altra organizzazione che fornisce servizi.
localizedDescriptions.fr: Cela permet d’indiquer si l'analyse a été réalisé directement au point de soins (POCT), par opposition à un résultat officiel provenant d’un laboratoire ou d’un autre prestataire de services.
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 此项数据元旨在表明当前的检验项目究竟是床旁（Point-of-Care，POCT）直接进行的检验项目，而不是实验室或其他服务机构/部门/科室所提供的正式结果。
localizedDescriptions.es: Indica si la prueba se realizó directamente en el punto de atención (POCT), en contraposición a un resultado formal de un laboratorio u otra organización de prestación de servicios.
localizedDescriptions.nb: Dette indikerer hvorvidt analysen ble utført gjennom pasientnær analysering (PNA) i stedet for en mer formell laboratorietjeneste.
localizedDescriptions.ca: Indica si la prova es va fer directament al punt d'atenció (POCT), en contraposició a un resultat formal d'un laboratori o una altra organització de prestació de serveis.
localizedDescriptions.nl: *This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.(en)
